title: Veasel Code authentic CLI/TUI terminal demo
disclaimer: Asciicast built from real veasel/veasel-tui 0.64.7-next.0 output against a local loopback backend. Scripted keystrokes for /help, /mcp, and /connect. No live model calls and no benchmark scores.
tooling: asciicast v2 writer + pexpect; binaries from the SHA-256-verified release archive
credential_policy: isolated temporary HOME and XDG_CONFIG_HOME; provider API-key environment variables are not inherited
flows: veasel-tui: /help, /mcp, /connect OpenCode Go (stops at API key prompt), q quit
